title: Textured Editorial
description: Illustration éditoriale numérique plate combinant des blocs de couleurs sans ombres avec des contours texturés au fusain ou au crayon. Les formes sont définies par des teintes unies superposées et des lignes organiques légèrement décalées, créant une esthétique moderne et naïve sans dégradés.
description_en: Flat digital editorial illustration combining unshaded color blocking with loose, textured charcoal or crayon outlines. Forms are defined by overlapping flat hues and slightly misregistered, organic linework, creating a modern, naive aesthetic devoid of gradient shading.
description_fr: Illustration éditoriale numérique plate combinant des blocs de couleurs sans ombres avec des contours texturés au fusain ou au crayon. prompt: Flat digital editorial illustration combining crisp vector-like shapes with traditional textured linework. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render the scene using strictly unshaded, flat color blocks dominated by {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, with strategic pops of {{accent_color}}. The lighting anatomy is completely flat and ambient, intentionally devoid of gradients, directional shadows, or specular highlights. Define forms using loose, organic, charcoal or crayon-style black outlines that exhibit varied pressure sensitivity and rough grain. These outlines should occasionally float, overlap, or slightly misregister from the underlying color fills, creating a relaxed, hand-drawn aesthetic. Keep color fills mostly smooth but allow their borders to have slightly imperfect, organic contours rather than rigid geometric cuts. Spatial dynamics are compressed into a flat 2D plane, relying on overlapping graphic silhouettes and scale contrast rather than forced perspective. Embrace a minimalist approach to internal details, allowing large expanses of negative space and unbroken color to dominate the composition. Avoid any 3D rendering, subsurface scattering, or photorealistic elements. The visual rhythm is dictated by the interplay of bold, solid hues and the scratchy, kinetic energy of the black contour lines. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. flat illustration, editorial art, naive graphic style, crayon linework, unshaded colors, solid color blocks, misregistered outlines, charcoal contour, 2d vector aesthetic, modern editorial, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Color blocks shift with a slight boil effect, while the charcoal outlines jitter and redraw continuously at a low frame rate (e.g., 12fps) to simulate hand-drawn animation.
video.camera: Camera remains static or uses slow, locked-off 2D pans, strictly avoiding any 3D parallax or perspective shifts.
video.temporal_texture: The crayon-like grain on the outlines boils constantly, while the flat color fills remain perfectly solid and unshaded throughout the motion.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 60fps interpolation, 3D camera rotations, gradient shading, and motion blur, which destroy the flat, hand-drawn editorial aesthetic.
